purpose: The one line a page shows while it revalidates and after, a note for a copy that could not be brought up to date, and a refresh button's feedback in plain words.
namedChanges: the header comment loses its cycle tag, and the comment of `whenText` loses its batch tag;
`whenText(ms, now?, locale?)`: a new third parameter. Without it the time follows the runtime locale and the day is written as en-GB, as before;

`UpdatedLine`, `StaleNote`: new optional props `labels`, `locale`, `className`. `RefreshNoteLine`: new optional props `className`, `errorClassName`. `plainWhy(error, noReason?)`: a new second parameter. `useRefreshNote(run, sigNow, options?)`: a new third parameter `{ labels }`, read at press time so `press` keeps its identity;

the sentences ("Updating…", "Updated <when>", the stale note, "the platform did not answer", "Updated just now", "Nothing new", the could-not-update sentence) and the four class strings move into `DEFAULT_LABELS` and `DEFAULT_CLASSES` with the same text, and the code reads them from there.
No default value, role, aria attribute or test id changed.

library.title: Updated line (Updating... / Updated 14:05)
library.note: Only the status line, the stale note and the refresh-button feedback; the data and the hook are use-cached. For a plain button take button.
